description: This file defines a Spring configuration class for setting up an ExternalEventSourceProvider bean within the Fineract project. It specifies the base package for external event classes and provides a bean method to instantiate the provider with this configuration.

classes.name: ExternalEventSourceProviderConfig
classes.description: Spring configuration class that provides an ExternalEventSourceProvider bean configured with a base package for external event classes.

methods.name: fineractExternalEventSourceProvider
methods.description: Defines a bean that creates and returns a SimpleExternalEventSourceProvider initialized with the base package for external event classes.
